### Log file

Please attach the file `godot.log`: drag it into this box. Ontomeme keeps a
log of every time it runs. To find it, press Ctrl+P (Cmd+P on a Mac) and
choose "Open log folder", or open the folder for your computer:

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Ontomeme\logs\godot.log`
  (paste the folder part into the address bar of File Explorer)
- Mac: `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Ontomeme/logs/godot.log`
  (in Finder, choose Go > Go to Folder... and paste the folder part)
- Linux: `~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Ontomeme/logs/godot.log`

`godot.log` is from the last time Ontomeme ran. If you have opened Ontomeme
again since the problem, attach the older log from that time as well. It is
in the same folder, named with its date and time, such as
`godot2026-11-07T22.08.46.log`.

The log is plain text, so you can open it and read it before you send it.
If the folder isn't there, Ontomeme never got far enough to start: say so
here.
